user.title: MC Overwatch
user.description: Connect to the mc-ha-exporter running on the Mac. Install it first by launching mc-ha-exporter.app (the host address is shown in its status panel; use the 'Copy HA config' button to grab everything).

data.host: Host (the Mac's LAN IP; a http://ip:port/ paste works too)
data.token: Access token (use the 'Copy HA config' button in the app panel)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure MC server
reconfigure.description: Change host/port/token; entities and history are kept.

data.host: Host (the Mac's LAN IP; a http://ip:port/ paste works too)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MC server
reauth_confirm.description: The token was rejected by the exporter (403). Paste a fresh token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the exporter. Check host/port, and that the macOS firewall allows inbound python3.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong token (403). Use the 'Copy HA config' button in the app panel to copy it again.
